roofed_forest.habitat: Humid wooded hills, with gradual edges, clear waterways and fewer trees at high elevation.
roofed_forest.structure: Existing woodland mansion policy, restricted to this biome and suitable terrain.

pale_garden.habitat: Rare sheltered humid valleys, benches and basin woodland; irregular boundaries.
pale_garden.behavior: Native biome suppresses ordinary animal spawning. Hearts require aligned logs, natural=true, a saved native block actor and vanilla ticks; flowers keep vanilla day/night behavior.

cherry_grove.habitat: Sunny foothills and stable terraces above lakes; spreading crowns, petals and open grassy gaps.

mangrove_swamp.habitat: Warm wet coastal/estuarine lowlands linked to the local water network; never isolated high plateaus.
mangrove_swamp.behavior: Submerged roots retain source water in Bedrock's secondary layer; hanging propagules require leaf support.

dappled_forest.habitat: Cool wooded hills and valley terraces with coherent color stands, fallen logs and clearings.
dappled_forest.behavior: Shelf mushrooms use growth and cardinal direction states with adjacent log support.
